title: The Letter M — M is for Moses
objective: Students will learn the letter M and its sound using the Bible word Moses.
content: Today we learn the letter M! The letter M makes the sound 'mmm' like in the word Moses. Can you say 'mmm'?
Moses was a very special man in the Bible. When he was a baby, his mommy put him in a basket on the river to keep him safe. A princess found baby Moses and took care of him!
M is also in the words Moon, Mommy, and Milk. Press your lips together to make the 'mmm' sound. M-M-Moses!
activity: Trace the letter M with your finger. Draw a picture of baby Moses in his basket. Find things that start with M.
discussion: What sound does the letter M make?
Where did the princess find baby Moses?
Can you name something that starts with M?
